_doc: Compatibility baseline for h2a 0.98.x. Gateway integration uses cluster-mesh; the 0.98.1 release versions are assigned separately by the release owner.

@sentropic/h2a.role: Core coordination and public CLI/MCP contracts

@sentropic/h2a-runtime.role: Local host, sessions and daemon; owns the qualified gateway dependencies

@sentropic/cluster-mesh.role: Gateway composition and sole provider integration surface

@sentropic/llm-gateway.role: Runtime dependency selected through cluster-mesh; no direct h2a import

@sentropic/llm-mesh.role: Runtime dependency selected through cluster-mesh; one physical copy shared with gateway

compat.rule: h2a-cli and h2a-runtime follow the h2a lockstep version. Cluster-mesh and its selected providers use the qualified exact tuple; the Pod bridge is versioned separately.
